found_at: https://eodhd.com/ header logo (<svg class=site-header__logo-icon><use xlink:href="/img/eod_logo.svg#logo">); the same sprite is used on eodhd.com/financial-apis/
edits: kept the #logo path (element 0: disc with the three candlesticks cut out); removed the #label 'EODHD APIs' wordmark (element 1)
recoloured currentColor to #F05F40, the colour of EODHD's own favicon.ico / favicon.png
cropped the viewBox to the mark (pad 0.02)
notes: The header draws this path in currentColor (white on the dark header), so the colour was taken from the favicon (#F05F40; the site CSS's --orange-color is #FD633E). The candlesticks are cut-outs, so they show the tile colour (dark on the dark theme) instead of the favicon's painted white.
license: EODHD brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with EODHD.
